answer: Gate seats by Cheeger cut expansion: each mutual-vouch cluster must keep h>=0.35 on its 2-hop graph or its seats collapse to one. A willow of farmed clones sharing nectar edges forms a dense lagoon clique with h near 0, so the gate merges them. Param: h_min=0.35 recomputed each epoch. Attacker cost: each extra fake needs fresh cross-cluster edges to outsiders, roughly linear in fakes times outside degree. Honest weakness: sparse niche communities can look clique-like and get under-weighted.
